title: dlq.entry v1
invariants: An event no officer could handle after retries. Its consumer is the Herald; its destination is the editor — by definition, an escalation. Field names follow the canonical Conclave DLQEntry (vitruvyan-core, transport/dlq.py) so a reader fluent in one bus reads the other; idempotency_key is sha256(stream:event_id:group) truncated, deterministic.
